The city of Rochester is taking steps to close the skills gap by bringing together businesses and educators 
 to provide workers with the necessary skills to succeed in in-demand jobs 📚. This initiative has the potential to have a lasting impact on the community 
 and could be a model for other cities to follow 💡. What do you think is the most important step in addressing the skills gap in your area? #Rochester #SkillsGap #EducationMatters #FutureOfWork #EconomicGrowth #BusinessAndEducation #Collaboration
